verdict: Paid Instagram is profitable this period, but low click-through and thin engagement suggest creative fatigue is capping growth.
diagnosis: Instagram ads spent $2,166 for $11,972 in sales this period — return of 5.5x — but cost per purchase sits at $3.85 with weak lead economics.

signals.headline: Ads returned 5.5x on $2,166 spend
signals.detail: Instagram campaign drove $11,972 in tracked purchases this period. Healthy return, but volume remains small at 562 purchases.

signals.headline: 562 purchases at $3.85 each
signals.detail: Cost per purchase is strong for a subscription box. Room to scale spend if creative and landing page hold up.

signals.headline: Click-through rate only 0.02%
signals.detail: Latest period click-through is far below the 1%+ norm for paid social. Creative is not stopping the scroll.

signals.headline: 952 new follows this period

signals.headline: 272 reviews, 5-star latest rating

recommendations.title: Test three new creative angles for Muslim Box
recommendations.detail: Click-through is 0.02% latest. Consider halal sourcing proof, unboxing video, and customer testimonial angles to lift the 5.5x return before scaling spend.

recommendations.title: Build email and SMS flows to lift repeat revenue
recommendations.detail: Category leaders pull 30% of revenue from owned channels. Worth exploring welcome, abandoned cart, and post-purchase sequences to convert the 237 add-to-carts.

recommendations.title: Reply to recent reviews and request more
recommendations.detail: 272 reviews with fresh 5-star entries is strong local proof. Test a post-delivery review ask to compound the trust signal driving 8,183 map impressions.
